title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 50
description: Ten questions on Psalms 50: God calls heaven and earth to judge his people, owns the livestock on a thousand hills, and asks for the sacrifice of thanksgiving.

questions.text: From where to where does God call the earth in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:1 says God "calls the earth from sunrise to sunset."

answers.text: From the river to the desert
From the north to the south

questions.text: Out of which place, "the perfection of beauty," does God shine out?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:2 says, "Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out."

questions.text: What devours before God as he comes?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:3 says, "A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him."

questions.text: God's saints have made a covenant with him by what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:5 says, "Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

questions.text: God says the livestock on how many hills are his?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:10 says, "For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills."

questions.text: Why would God not tell his people if he were hungry?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:12 says, "If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it."

answers.text: He never speaks to his people
The world and all that is in it are his
His people have nothing to give

questions.text: According to verse 14, what sacrifice are the people told to offer to God?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:14 says, "Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High."

questions.text: When does God tell his people to call on him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:15 says, "Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me."

questions.text: What did the wicked do when they saw a thief?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:18 says, "When you saw a thief, you consented with him."

questions.text: Whom does the wicked person slander, according to verse 20?
questions.explanation: Psalms 50:20 says, "You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother's son."
